### Data Attributes {#button-data-attributes}

| Attribute                                                        | Applied when                                                | Purpose                                                  |
| ---------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------- |
| data-slot="root"                                                 | Always                                                      | Stable root slot selector for wrapper styling.           |
| data-slot="label"                                                | Always                                                      | Stable label slot selector for wrapper styling.          |
| data-slot="leading-icon"                                         | Leading icon or loading spinner is rendered                 | Stable leading adornment selector.                       |
| data-slot="trailing-icon"                                        | Trailing icon is rendered                                   | Stable trailing adornment selector.                      |
| data-slot="spinner"                                              | `loading` is `true`                                         | Stable loading indicator selector.                       |
| data-pressed                                                     | The underlying Spar button exposes its pressed/toggle state | Styling hook for pressed treatments.                     |
| data-disabled                                                    | `disabled` is `true`                                        | Styling hook for the disabled state.                     |
| data-loading                                                     | `loading` is `true`                                         | Styling hook for the loading state.                      |
| data-type / data-variant / data-size / data-mode                 | Always                                                      | Product styling hooks for visual variants and semantics. |
| data-full-width / data-icon-only / data-rounded / data-underline | When the corresponding product prop is enabled              | Anatomy and layout hooks for Button recipes.             |
